UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE NOTICE OF SUBSEQUENT RECORD DEVELOPMENT RELEVANT TO ECF NOS. 93 AND 97–99

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves under Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) for leave to file the Notice of Subsequent Record Development attached as Exhibit A. A Memorandum in Support accompanies this Motion.

I.	GROUNDS

1.	Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) provides that “[n]o further briefs or written communications may be filed without first obtaining leave of Court.”

2.	ECF No. 93 (Motion for Targeted Vacatur of ECF Nos. 64 and 84, Withdrawal or Modification of the Magistrate-Judge Referral, and Related Interim Relief) and ECF Nos. 97–99 (Rule 72(a) Objections to ECF No. 96 and related requests) are pending before the District Judge. Plaintiff’s consolidated reply in support of ECF Nos. 90 and 93 was filed October 28, 2026. ECF No. 102.

3.	On October 29, 2026, Magistrate Judge Fitzpatrick signed ECF No. 108. It was filed October 29, 2026 and entered on the docket October 30, 2026. ECF No. 108 is a subsequent exercise of the designation. The authority and procedure that produced that designation are the subject of ECF No. 97 ¶ 15 and ECF No. 99, Part V. ECF No. 108 attributes to the District Judge a decision to refrain from beginning discovery until resolution of the pending motions to dismiss. ECF No. 108 at 2. It postdates ECF No. 102 and ECF Nos. 97–99.

II.	SCOPE

4.	The proposed Notice is confined to ECF No. 108. It addresses its date, its stated premise, and its relationship to the relief already requested in ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R1), (R5), and (R6) and ECF No. 97 ¶¶ 15 and 20(6)–(7). It repeats no argument from ECF Nos. 94, 99, or 102 and adds no ground. Plaintiff’s motions under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 54(b), filed separately, request reconsideration of ECF No. 108 insofar as it denied ECF Nos. 103 and 105. This Motion does not request that reconsideration.

III.	RELIEF

5.	Plaintiff requests leave to file Exhibit A. Plaintiff requests that it be deemed filed as of the date of the Court’s order. Plaintiff requests that the Court consider it in resolving ECF Nos. 93 and 97–99, with such opportunity for Defendants to respond as the Court directs. A proposed order accompanies this Motion.

Date: November 1, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se

1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847

Alexandria, Virginia 22307

(407) 794-6503

jayballentine@protonmail.com

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

I certify that on November 1, 2026, I submitted the following documents to the Clerk of Court for filing through the Court’s Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS):

1.	Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Notice of Subsequent Record Development Relevant to ECF Nos. 93 and 97–99, with its Certificate of Service, Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) Certification, and Generative Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification;

2.	Memorandum in Support;

3.	Exhibit A (Proposed Notice of Subsequent Record Development); and

4.	Proposed Order.

Counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, Katie Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc. are registered users of the Court’s Case Management/Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) system. Upon the Clerk’s docketing of the submission, the CM/ECF system will transmit a Notice of Electronic Filing to each of them, and service will be made through that means under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 5(b)(2)(E). EDSS submission is not itself service.

Date: November 1, 2026

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se
